semiconductor_relevance: High — Kashiyama Europe GmbH specializes in vacuum pump systems critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Kashiyama Europe GmbH manufactures reliable and low-maintenance dry Multi-Stage Roots Pumps, essential for semiconductor and coating applications. With a strong presence in Japan and a growing team in Europe, they provide high-quality vacuum solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.Europe: Kashiyama Europe GmbH was established to support European customers with sales and service, emphasizing 'Made in Japan Quality'.
